bills.summary: Extends the payroll-tax substitution (CPRB) relief for certain sectors.
Requires equal pay for women and men doing the same job.
Sets 80% minimum sentence served before regime progression for a type of aggravated homicide.
Defines the tax immunity of religious and non-profit entities.
Creates a national strategy to train medical specialists within the Mais Médicos programme.
Changes sanctions on parties that missed gender and race funding quotas, including amnesty for past breaches.
Repeals provisions of the labor code (CLT).
Suspends parts of a decree on regionalised basic sanitation services.
Reopens rural-credit debt renegotiation and extends it to micro-entrepreneurs.
Creates the new fiscal framework (arcabouço fiscal) replacing the spending cap.
Creates commissioned functions at the Federal District court of justice.
Grants amnesty and sentence reductions linked to political demonstrations since October 2022.
Creates a national policy for decent work for homeless people.
Lets pension-plan redemption rights serve as loan collateral.
Sets the minimum wage and a permanent real-increase policy.
Creates a National Day of Congados and Reinados.
Sets tie-breaking rules at the federal tax appeals council (CARF) and tax-compliance measures.
Criminalizes discrimination against politically exposed persons and limits banks refusing them accounts.
Creates the Food Acquisition Programme (PAA) and the Solidarity Kitchen programme.
Opens an extraordinary R$200 million credit for the Agriculture Ministry.
Sets federal compensation to states for fuel-tax losses and related debt deductions.
Regulates fixed-odds betting.
Sets the procedure for constitutional-review cases before the Supreme Court.
Raises penalties for theft and robbery.
Creates a crime of financial abuse of children and adolescents.
Declares August the month for combating inequalities.
Gives states and municipalities more time for budget transfers and reprogramming.
Sets guidelines for national industrial, technology and foreign-trade policy.
Changes the apportionment of seats in the Chamber of Deputies, raising their number.
Taxes income from offshore investments and exclusive investment funds.
Regulates the tax credit arising from investment subsidies.
Changes the agrarian-reform law on rural property.
